provenance: Public authored examples; no private traffic or organization data.

documents.title: Auroras
documents.text: Auroras form when charged particles from the sun interact with gases in Earth’s atmosphere.

documents.title: Boiling water
documents.text: At standard atmospheric pressure, pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius. Lower pressure reduces its boiling point.

documents.title: Photosynthesis
documents.text: Plants use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make sugars through photosynthesis, releasing oxygen.

documents.title: Secure Shell
documents.text: SSH provides encrypted remote access to a computer. Public key authentication uses a private key kept by the client.

documents.title: Rust ownership
documents.text: Rust ownership and borrowing manage memory without a garbage collector. A value has one owner and references obey borrowing rules.

documents.title: Database indexes
documents.text: A database index can speed up row lookup, but takes storage and adds work to inserts and updates.

documents.title: Cache expiration
documents.text: A cache stores reusable results. A time to live specifies when an entry expires and must be fetched again.

documents.title: Moon phases
documents.text: The Moon reflects sunlight. Its phases change because we see different portions of its sunlit half as it orbits Earth.

documents.title: Backups
documents.text: A backup is an independent copy of data used for recovery. Test restoration regularly and keep copies in separate locations.

documents.title: Text embeddings
documents.text: Text embeddings represent text as numerical vectors. Similarity between normalized vectors can be measured with their dot product.
